about_the_game:
Think you know how to beat this level? Think again.

You're here again. Same room. Same door. But each time — a completely different puzzle. Welcome to the sequel of the indie game that will flip your perception of logic games upside down.

🎮 ABOUT THE GAME

That Level Again 2 is a minimalist puzzle game where the same level becomes dozens of different challenges. Our hero is still trying to escape, but now even more devious and unexpected obstacles await.

⭐ KEY FEATURES

70+ unique solutions — each playthrough requires a new approach

Deceptive simplicity — minimalist design hides genius puzzles

Meta-gameplay — play with your expectations and gaming conventions

Humor and absurdity — unexpected twists and hilarious solutions

Achievements and secrets — for the most attentive explorers

Perfect for streaming — viewers love giving hints (though not always the right ones!)

🧩 GAMEPLAY

Forget everything you know about platformers. Here, jumping can kill you, standing still might open the door, and sometimes the solution lies beyond the game field itself.

[spoiler] Experiment with everything: controls, physics, even the game settings![/spoiler]

Each new level is the same visual set: hero, platforms, door, and button. But the rules change every time. What worked a minute ago will now lead to failure.

📖 STORY

Our nameless hero is stuck in an endless loop of identical rooms. The only way out is a door that stubbornly refuses to open the usual way. Can you help him find freedom? Or perhaps freedom is just an illusion?

💡 WHO IS THIS GAME FOR?

  • Lovers of unconventional puzzles

  • Fans of the first game

  • Those tired of repetitive indie games

  • Streamers and their viewers

Playtime: 2-4 hours of intense brainstorming

That Level Again 2 isn't just a game — it's a challenge to your thinking. Are you ready to accept it?

Remember: the obvious solution almost never works. 🚪
